hero.h1: The single access point to the region's regulatory information
hero.lead: The NA-MRH Digital Collaboration Platform brings together the National Regulatory Authorities of North Africa: institutional communication, secure collaboration and regulatory knowledge management.

homeSections.missionH: A platform built phase by phase
homeSections.missionP: Designed as a progressive, modular build, the platform delivers a complete, usable tool at the end of every three-month phase — without waiting for the full project to be completed.
homeSections.twgP: Each TWG is co-led by two member countries and prioritised into waves according to its maturity.

governance.p: The Secretariat is hosted by Tunisia; North Africa has no standing REC Secretariat yet.
governance.steeringD: Directors General of the National Regulatory Authorities — validates strategy, terms of reference and roadmaps.
governance.secretariatD: Hosted by Tunisia (ANMPS) · Coordinator: Dr Mariam Aounallah · Planning, reporting, partner liaison.
governance.twgLevelD: Two co-leads per group · guidelines, SOPs, joint activities.
governance.partnersP: AUDA-NEPAD · African Medicines Agency (AMA) · WHO · Swissmedic · World Bank · AfDB

newsPage.p: Tracking Secretariat, working-group and partner activities.

contactPage.p: The NA-MRH Secretariat, hosted by Tunisia, coordinates exchanges with the member countries and partners.
contactPage.secP: Coordinator: Dr Mariam Aounallah — hosted by ANMPS, Tunisia.
contactPage.nraT: Contacts of the National Regulatory Authorities
contactPage.confirmSent: Message sent — the Secretariat will reply shortly.
contactPage.errorSent: Something went wrong. Please try again.

complaintsPage.p: Not satisfied with a Secretariat service? Let us know: every complaint is reviewed and tracked through to resolution.
complaintsPage.confirmP: Your complaint has been forwarded to the NA-MRH Secretariat, which will follow up after review.
complaintsPage.errorSent: Something went wrong. Please try again.

comingSoon.p: This section is on the roadmap and will be delivered in a forthcoming rollout step.
comingSoon.notice: The platform is built phase by phase: each section goes live once it is complete and verified, rather than half-finished.

notFoundPage.p: The requested address does not exist. It may have been mistyped, or the link that brought you here is out of date.

membersPage.h: Member States and National Regulatory Authorities
membersPage.p: Each country manages its own internal users and contributes to the regional document repository within a shared framework.

libraryPage.p: Deposit, classification and search of regulatory documents produced by the Secretariat and the working groups.
libraryPage.notice: Full document access requires authentication through the secure RIMS Portal.
libraryPage.restrictedNote: {{n}} additional document(s) marked internal or confidential are only visible through the secure portal.
libraryPage.empty: No public document in this category.

twgsPage.p: Prioritised into three waves on 18 August 2026 — Secretariat support follows the ranking.
twgsPage.notFound: This working group could not be found.

footer.aboutP: North African Medicines Regulatory Harmonization Initiative — pharmaceutical regulatory convergence in North Africa, aligned with the priorities of the African Medicines Agency (AMA) and AUDA-NEPAD.
footer.partners: Technical & financial partners: AUDA-NEPAD · AMA · WHO · Swissmedic · World Bank · AfDB  ·  © 2026 NA-MRH Secretariat

adminHome.intro: Home page texts and Secretariat contact details. Each field is pre-filled with the current text. A language left identical to the default text is not saved. Changes appear on the public site immediately.
adminHome.notModifiedIn: Default text kept in: {{langs}}. Remember to translate the change.
adminHome.sectionsLegend: Sections shown on the home page
adminHome.sectionsHelp: The main banner is always shown. At least one other section must remain visible.
adminHome.lastSection: Last visible section: it cannot be hidden.

fields.statsLabels_1: Figure 2: label (number of working groups, calculated)

auth.title: Sign in
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended (account deactivated or deleted, or session expired). Please sign in again.
auth.sessionCheckFailed: Unable to verify your session: the server is not responding. Your sign-in is kept.
auth.deniedP: Your access level ({{level}}) does not allow you to view this page.

adminCountries.intro: Management of Member State accounts: identity, NRA contact details, and role in the regional organisation.
adminCountries.note: TWG roles (lead / co-lead) are managed from the Working groups tab; each country's users from the User management tab.

adminUsers.intro: Internal users of the National Regulatory Authorities and the Secretariat.
adminUsers.confirmDeactivate: Do you want to deactivate the account of {{name}}?
adminUsers.confirmReactivate: Do you want to reactivate the account of {{name}}?
adminUsers.passwordKeepL: Password (leave empty to keep it unchanged)
adminUsers.note: Accounts are never deleted, only deactivated: a user may be the author of documents whose history must be kept. A deactivated account can no longer sign in.

adminDocuments.intro: All documents produced by the working groups, whatever their status. Changing the status to “Published to the public” makes a document immediately visible in the public Library; any other status keeps it restricted to the secure portal.
adminDocuments.note: Versioning, comments and a detailed history for each document will come in a later stage (Phase 4).

adminNews.intro: News shown on the public site. An unpublished draft never appears publicly, only here.

adminTwgs.intro: Working group content shown on the public site. Changes appear immediately on the “Working groups” page.

profile.title: My profile
profile.help: You can change your name and email address. Your access level and country are managed by the Secretariat.
profile.passwordHint: Only required to change your email address.
